senses.gloss:
mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं)
Healthy, well.
E.
अ neg. रुग्न sick.

f. (-चिः)
1 Aversion, dislike.
2 Want of appetite, disrelish, disgust.
E.
अ neg. रुचि light.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Disagreeable, disgusting.
E.
अ neg. रुचिर agreeable.

mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं)
Disagreeable.
E.
अ neg. रुच्य to be liked.

mfn. (-रुक् or -रुग्)
Sound, healthy, free from disease.
E.
अ neg. रुज् sick.

m. (-णः)
1 A name of the sun.
2 Also of his charioteer, or the dawn personified as the son of KAŚYAPA by VINATĀ.
3 The colour of the dawn, dark red, or the mixture of red and black.
4 Tawny, (the colour.)
5 The redness of sun-set.
6 A kind of leprosy, with red spots and insensibility of the skin.
7 A dumb man.
f. (-णा)
1 A plant, (Betula.) See अतिविषा.
2 Madder, (Rubia manjith.)
3 Another plant, commonly Tëori. See त्रिष्टत्.
4 A black kind of the same.
5 Colocynth or bitter apple.
6 The plant that yields the red and black berry from which the jeweller's weight, the Ratti, is derived. See गुञ्जा.
mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Tawny, dark red, &c.
E.
ऋ to go, and उनन Uṇādi aff.

n. (-लं)
The red lotus.
E.
अरुण, and कमल a lotus.

m. (-नः)
A pigeon.
E.
अरुण, and लोचन the eye.

m. (-थिः)
The sun.
E.
अरुण, and सारथि a charioteer; whose charioteer is ARUṆA.

m. (-जः)
GARUḌA, the bird of VIṢṆU.
E.
अरुण, and अग्रज first born; having ARUṆA as his elder brother.

m. (-जः)
A name of JAṬĀYU, a fabulous bird: said by some to be the son of ARUṆA, but more generally of GARUḌA.
E.
अरुण, and आत्मज the son.

m. (-जः)
A name of GARUḌA.
E.
अरुण, अवर after, and ज born; the younger brother of ARUṆA.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Reddened.
2 Dyed red, impurpled.
E.
अरुण and इतच् aff.

m. (-मा)
Redness.
E.
अरुण and इमनिच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Reddened, turning or become red.
E.
अरुण, and कृत made, च्ची augment.

m. (-यः)
Break of day, dawn, the period preceding sunset.
E.
अरुण dawn, उदय rise.

m. (-लः)
A ruby.
E.
अरुण dark red, and उपल a stone.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Unwept, unlamented.
2 Not weeping.
E.
अ neg. रुदित wept.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
Free, unobstructed.
E.
अ neg. रुद्ध obstructed.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
1 Sharp, corrosive.
2 Acrimonious, sharp, sour. (as disposition.)
E.
अरुस् a sore, and तुद what torments, from तुद and खश affix; the final of अरुस् is dropped, and नुम inserted.

n. (-त्वं)
1 Infliction of pain.
2 Acrimoniousness, causticity.
E.
त्व added to the last. Also अरुन्तुदता.

f. (-ती)
The daughter of KĀRDDAMA and wife of VASIṢṬHA, one of the seven Ṛṣis; she is also one of the Pleiades.
E.
अ neg. रुध to confine, तन् and ङीप् affixes; who does not confine or hinder good works. ARUNDHATĪ is considered as a pattern of conjugal excellence, and is invoked at the marriage ceremony by the bridegroom.

m. (-निः)
VAŚIṢṬHA, one of the seven Ṛṣis or saints, and stars in the great bear.
E.
अरुन्धती and जानि from जाया a wife; whose wife is ARUNDHATĪ.

m. (-थः)
A name of VASIṢṬHA, as above.
E.
अरुन्धती and नाथ a lord or husband.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Smooth, liter. or fig.
E.
अ neg. रुश rough.

m. (-षः)
1 A kind of snake.
2 The sun.
E.
ऋ to go, ऊषन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-ष्कः)
The marking-nut plant, see the next word.
E.
अरुस् a sore, and क what makes.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Corrosive, caustic, acrid.
m. (-रः)
The marking-nut plant, (Semecarpius anacardium.)
n. (-रं)
The nut.
E.
अरुस् a sore, कृ to make, ट aff.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Calm, not angry.
E.
अ neg. रुष्ट angry.

mfn. (-रुः)
A sore or wound.
m. (-रुः)
The sun.
ind.
A joint.
E.
ऋ to go, and उसि Uṇādi aff.

f. (का)
Eruptions on the scalp, with acute pain.
E.
अरुस् a sore, कन् added.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पी-पं)
1 Formless, shapeless.
2 Ugly, ill formed, misshapen.
3 Dissimilar, unlike.
E.
अ neg. रूप beauty.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Literal, without figure or metaphor.
E.
अ neg. रूपक figurative.

f. (-ता)
1 Ugliness.
2 Shapelessness.
3 Dissimilarity.
E.
तल् added to अरूप, also अरूपत्व.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Ugly, shapeless.
E.
अरूप and मतुप् aff.

m. (-रुः)
1 The name of a tree, (Lagerstroemia regina.)
2 A crab.
3 A hog.
4 A pitcher.
E.
ऋ to go, उण् affix, the pen. made long.

mfn. (-रूः-रूः-रु)
Of a tawny colour.
m. (-रूः)
Tawny, (the colour.)
E.
ऋ to go, ऊ aff.

n. (-कं)
A drug brought from the hills, of cooling properties.

mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु)
Desirous to rise or ascend, to advance, &c.
E.
आङ् before रुह to rise, desiderative form, उ aff.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
1 Mounted, ascended, risen.
2 Raised up, elevated on high.
E.
आङ् before रुह to grow, क्त aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Mounting, rising.
E.
आङ् before रुह to mount, क्तवतु aff.
